cards.content:
# All bento cards
Every bento card on one page, using live data. The options for each card are on the [Library](/bento-library/index) page. **Careful:** these controls are real, so Serve feeds the cats and toggles switch real devices.

# Bento Library
Every custom bento card in this Home Assistant, each on its own page with a live example, its options and a config you can copy. The cards live in `/config/www/bento-*.js`; shared tokens and helpers are in `bento-core.js` (v1.0.0).

| Card | Source | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| [bento-sky](/bento-library/sky) | bento-cards.js 1.15.0 | Sky header: sun-tracking gradient, weather, greeting, presence |
| [bento-tabs](/bento-library/tabs) | bento-cards.js 1.15.0 | Pill tabs that host any cards |
| [bento-grid](/bento-library/grid) | bento-cards.js 1.15.0 | The landing bento, packed from `sensor.bento_tiles` |
| [bento-rooms](/bento-library/rooms) | bento-cards.js 1.15.0 | One tile per area, coloured when lights are on |
| [bento-room](/bento-library/room) | bento-cards.js 1.15.0 | Room-page hero: back, status, lights, scenes |
| [bento-controls](/bento-library/controls) | bento-cards.js 1.15.0 | Any entities as packed tiles, plus power bars, Adaptive Lighting, Vestaboard and LED strips |
| [bento-lists](/bento-library/lists) | bento-lists.js 1.0.1 | Live to-do lists side by side |
| [bento-snack](/bento-library/snack) | bento-feeder.js 3.3.3 | Snack time! with a two-tap Serve |
| [bento-feeder](/bento-library/feeder) | bento-feeder.js 3.3.3 | Aqara C1 feeders, per cat, with schedule controls |
| [bento-litter](/bento-library/litter) | bento-litter.js 1.3.1 | Litter-Robot 4: status, drawer, cats' weights |
| [bento-car](/bento-library/car) | bento-car.js 1.2.1 | A Tesla as six tiles |
| [bento-footer](/bento-library/footer) | bento-footer.js 1.2.0 | Menu and Edit pills; hides the top bar |

## Shared by every card
| Key | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `sun` | `sun.sun` | Night palette when this is `below_horizon` |
| `font_scale` | `1` | Sets `--bento-scale` |

- Every card is full-width (`getGridOptions` → `columns: full, rows: auto`). None has a visual editor, so configure them in YAML.
- **Tap** runs the main action. **Press and hold** (520 ms) opens more-info. Unlock, Serve, and reset take **two taps** within 4 s.
- **Tile shapes:** `S` small · `W` wide · `T` tall · `L` large · `F` full row · `FL` full and tall.
- **Tones:** hazard, act, today, car, plan, climate, cats, media, energy, scenes, money, night, water, festive, health, recycling, trash, muted, litter.
- Fonts (Bricolage Grotesque, Figtree) are loaded by `bento-cards.js`, so keep that resource registered even if you only use the other files.

## bento-sky
A header with a sky gradient that follows the sun's elevation. It draws weather effects, a sun or moon arc, a greeting with your first name, the date, sunrise and sunset, the temperature and presence pills.

| Key | Type | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `weather` | entity | `weather.forecast_home` |
| `persons` | list of `person.*` | `[]` |

Reads sun `elevation`, `next_rising` and `next_setting`, and weather `temperature`, `apparent_temperature` and `humidity`. It calls no services.

```yaml
type: custom:bento-sky
weather: weather.forecast_home
persons:
  - person.nikw
  - person.kat
```
[← Library](/bento-library/index)

## bento-tabs
A row of pill tabs. Each tab holds ordinary card configs, built with `createCardElement` the first time you open that tab.

| Key | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `tabs` | list | **Required**, must not be empty |
| `tabs[].id` | string | Used by `tab:<id>` routes |
| `tabs[].label` | string | Pill text |
| `tabs[].cards` | list of cards | Any card, bento or not |

The active tab is kept in sessionStorage `bento-tab`; it starts on the first tab. A child card can switch tabs by firing a `bento-tab` event, which is how bento-grid's `tab:` routes work.

```yaml
type: custom:bento-tabs
tabs:
  - id: climate
    label: Temps
    cards:
      - type: custom:bento-controls
        entities:
          - entity: climate.living_room_thermostat
            shape: L
  - id: lists
    label: Lists
    cards:
      - type: custom:bento-lists
        lists:
          - entity: todo.shopping_list
```
[← Library](/bento-library/index)

## bento-grid
The landing bento. It packs tiles into 4 columns (2 under 560 px), up to 20 cells, and draws a chart in each. The tiles come from `attributes.tiles` on a sensor built by `custom_templates/bento.jinja`.

| Key | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `entity` | entity | `sensor.bento_tiles` | |
| `base_path` | path | first URL segment | Where navigation goes |
| `routes` | map | `null` | Tile `tap` → view path, or `tab:<id>` to switch the parent bento-tabs. Once set, a tap with no route does nothing |

**Tile fields:** `id`, `tier` (0–4), `shape`, `label`, `tone`, `color`, `say`, `sub`, `big`, `badge`, `tap`, `filler`, `score`, `act` (`navigate`, `todo_add` or `service`), `viz`.

**`viz.type`:** spark, dayline, stack, board, list, buttons, tbar, tube, ring, thermo, charge, battery, kelvin, dbars, rain, checks, receipt, eq, flaps, garland.

Ticking and adding items always uses `todo.house_alerts` (that list is hardcoded).

```yaml
type: custom:bento-grid
entity: sensor.bento_tiles
base_path: /house-bento
routes:
  kitchen: room-kitchen
  cats: tab:cats
```
[← Library](/bento-library/index)

## bento-rooms
One tile per area. A room with lights on takes its colour; a dark room goes neutral. Chips show media, temperature, sleep mode, unlocked locks, open doors and windows, and offline locks. The bulb button switches the whole area; tapping the tile opens `{base_path}/room-<area_id>`.

| Key | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `areas` | list of area IDs | `null` | Sets order and colour. If unset, it uses the first bento-rooms on the dashboard that has `areas`, then all areas |
| `adaptive` | map area → switch(es) | `null` | Shows a sleep chip when `<switch>_sleep_mode` is on |
| `base_path` | path | first URL segment | |

Columns: 2 under 520 px, 3 under 760 px, otherwise 4. Calls `light.turn_on` / `light.turn_off` with an `area_id` target.

```yaml
type: custom:bento-rooms
base_path: /house-bento
areas: [living_room, kitchen, bedroom]
adaptive:
  bedroom: switch.adaptive_lighting_bedroom_suite
```
[← Library](/bento-library/index)

## bento-room
The hero at the top of a room page. It shows a ‹ Rooms back button, the room name, a status line, a lights on/off button and one button per scene in the area.

| Key | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `area` | area ID | — | **Required** |
| `areas` | list | shared list | Colour order; normally inherited from bento-rooms |
| `base_path` | path | — | |
| `back` | view path | `home` | Back target; also switches to the Rooms tab |

Calls `light.turn_on` / `light.turn_off` for the area and `scene.turn_on`.

```yaml
type: custom:bento-room
area: living_room
base_path: /house-bento
back: home
```
[← Library](/bento-library/index)

cards.heading: Lights with All on/off, LED strip and Adaptive Lighting

cards.content:
## bento-controls
Any list of entities drawn as packed bento tiles. Each domain has its own tile: light, switch, fan, input_boolean, media_player, climate, lock, binary_sensor, vacuum, scene and script, sensor, and select/number/text/time. Tap runs the main action and press-and-hold opens more-info. When more than one entity can be switched, an All on/off button appears in the header.

### Card keys
| Key | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `entities` | list | — | **Required**. Strings or objects (below) |
| `title` | string | `""` | |
| `tone` | tone name | `null` | |
| `room_tone` | number | `null` | Room colour index for “on” tiles |
| `strip` | string or list | `null` | Prefixes removed from friendly names. Inside `entities[]`, `strip` means an LED strip instead |
| `all` | bool | `null` | `false` hides All on/off |
| `spark_hours` | number | `24` | |

### Entity forms (the first matching key wins)
| Key | Extra keys | Default shape |
|---|---|---|
| `bars` (list) | `name` (Right now), `tone` (energy), `top` (8) | `F` |
| `adaptive` | `name`, `min`, `max` (K), `lights[]` | `W` |
| `board` | `name` (Vestaboard) | `W` |
| `strip` (light) | `palette`, `speed`, `intensity`, `reverse`, `freeze`, `name` | `L`/`FL` on, `W` off |
| `entity` | `name`, `shape`, `chart` (spark/bars/none), `hours`, `days` (14) | auto |

Columns: 2 under 420 px, 3 under 760 px, otherwise 4.

```yaml
type: custom:bento-controls
title: Lights
strip: [Living Room]
room_tone: 0
entities:
  - light.living_room_ceiling_light
  - entity: sensor.zig_weight
    chart: bars
    shape: W
  - adaptive: switch.adaptive_lighting_living_spaces
    min: 2200
    max: 5000
  - name: Circuits
    bars:
      - sensor.oven_power_minute_average
```
[← Library](/bento-library/index)

## bento-lists
To-do lists side by side (stacked under 520 px). Each list is a live `todo/item/subscribe` subscription where you can tick items, add, show done, and clear done.

| Key | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `lists` | list | — | **Required** |
| `lists[].entity` | `todo.*` | — | |
| `lists[].label` | string | friendly name | |
| `lists[].tone` | tone | `health` | |
| `lists[].placeholder` | string | `Add an item` | |
| `lists[].upper` | bool | — | Uppercases new items |
| `lists[].get` | bool | — | Says “things to get” instead of “to do” |

Calls `todo.update_item`, `todo.add_item` and `todo.remove_completed_items`.

```yaml
type: custom:bento-lists
lists:
  - entity: todo.shopping_list
    label: Shopping
    tone: today
    get: true
```
[← Library](/bento-library/index)

cards.heading: Live: Serve needs two taps and really feeds

cards.content:
## bento-snack
One full-width “Snack time!” tile with a two-tap Serve button.

| Key | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `script` | `script.*` | — | **Required**; called with `{portions}` |
| `title` | string | `Snack time!` | |
| `portions` | number | `1` | |
| `names` | list | `[]` | Cat names shown |
| `feeders` | list of prefixes | `[]` | Checks that `button.<prefix>_feed` is available |
| `heading` | string | — | |

```yaml
type: custom:bento-snack
script: script.cats_feed
portions: 1
names: [Donut, Zig]
feeders: [zigs_food, donuts_food]
```
[← Library](/bento-library/index)

## bento-feeder Aqara C1 feeders (ZHA). Each cat gets a tile with today's feeds, the last feed time and a drawing of the feeder. If `schedule` is set, a schedule tile with Pause, Lock and Light buttons is added. Tapping a tile never feeds. | Key | Type | Notes | |---|---|---| | `feeders` | list | **Required** | | `feeders[].name` | string | | | `feeders[].feeder` | prefix | e.g. `zigs_food` | | `feeders[].tone` | tone | Defaults to the cat tone for that position | | `schedule` | `automation.*` | Pause and resume | | `meals` | list of `{at, portions}` | Display only | | `heading` | string | | Reads `button.

_feed`, `sensor.

_portions_dispensed_today`, `binary_sensor.

_problem`, `switch.

_child_lock` and `switch.

_led_indicator`. ```yaml type: custom:bento-feeder heading: Food schedule: automation.cats_feeding_schedule feeders: - name: Zig feeder: zigs_food meals: - at: "07:00" portions: 4 ``` [← Library](/bento-library/index)

## bento-litter
A Litter-Robot 4 as tiles: a hero with status and a drawer bar, a drawing of the robot with litter and drawer levels, a weight tile for each cat with 14-day bars and visit dots, the globe light (Auto/On/Off), panel lock and wait time (3/7/15 min).

| Key | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `robot` | prefix | `litter_robot` | Entities are `<domain>.<robot>_<key>` |
| `name` | string | `Litter-Robot` | |
| `place` | string | `null` | Small label above the hero |
| `cats` | list of `{name, weight, visits, tone}` | `[]` | |
| `part` | `all` / `cats` / `robot` | `all` | Lets you split the card in two, as the house dashboard does |

Weights come from `recorder/statistics_during_period`. Reset takes two taps.

```yaml
type: custom:bento-litter
robot: litter_robot
place: Game room
part: all
cats:
  - name: Zig
    weight: sensor.zig_weight
    visits: sensor.zig_visits_today
```
[← Library](/bento-library/index)

## bento-car
One Tesla (tesla_fleet) as six tiles: a hero with the battery bar and location, an overhead drawing showing open doors, windows, frunk and trunk, cabin climate, charging and charge limit, sentry mode, and music.

| Key | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `car` | prefix | — | **Required**; entities are `<domain>.<car>_s_car_<key>` |
| `name` | string | `car` | Title reads “{name} car” |
| `model` | `3` / `S` / … | device model | `3` or `S` draws a sedan |

Unlocking takes two taps. The charge limit moves in steps of 5. Also calls `button.press` (wake), `climate.*`, `switch.*` and `media_player.*`.

```yaml
type: custom:bento-car
car: nik
name: Nik's
```
[← Library](/bento-library/index)

## bento-footer
Menu and Edit dashboard pills for the bottom of a page. On this page HA's top bar is hidden while the footer is showing; it comes back in edit mode. Use **[← Library](/bento-library/index)** to leave.

| Key | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `menu` | bool | `true` | Opens the HA sidebar |
| `edit` | bool | `true` | Shown only to admins |

Put one `bento-footer` last on every view of a bento dashboard.

```yaml
type: custom:bento-footer
```
